觸控晶片韌體更新（FW Upgrade）操作說明書

ILITek Touch FW Update SOP　|　Netronix

完整操作 Demo 影片

螢幕錄影，點擊觀看。涵蓋 adb reboot → 取得 FW 版本 → 執行更新 → 確認更新後版本 的完整流程。

第一章　執行前準備

  • 請先下載更新包並解壓縮（下載包內已含 adb.exe，無需另外安裝 adb）。
  • 透過 USB Type-C 將裝置連接到電腦。
📦 ILITek 更新包下載

第二章　確認當前 FW

解壓縮更新包後，進入 Scripts 資料夾（內含 adb.exe 與 FWUpgrade.bat）。

在上方的路徑列直接輸入 cmd，叫出終端機。

先輸入以下指令，將裝置重新開機：

adb reboot

等待裝置重開機完成、adb 重新連上後，再輸入以下指令確認當前 Touch FW 版本：

adb root
adb shell "dmesg | grep 'FW Version'"

畫面會顯示當前版本，例如 [ILITEK][MSG][0] [FW Version] 07-00-00-02, len: [4/4]。
（下方截圖示範機為更舊版本，故顯示 07-00-00-00）

⚠️ 重要：請在「重新開機後盡快」查詢
dmesg 為開機環形記錄，ILITEK 韌體資訊於開機初期（約第 9~10 秒）印出；請於重開機後盡快執行，否則可能被後續其他 Log 淹沒／覆蓋而查不到。若已查不到，重開機後再查即可。

第三章　執行更新

雙擊兩下 FWUpgrade.bat，程式會自動執行更新流程：

腳本會自動進行 ADB 連線檢測與檔案推送，並讀取更新前韌體資訊。

接著將韌體資料分塊（Block）寫入晶片並自動做 CRC 校驗：

updating block[6], data len: 1024...
block[6]: start/end addr... ic/file crc: 0xc230/0xc230 matched

當更新成功、進度條達到 100% 後，請輸入以下指令將裝置重新開機：

adb reboot

第四章　確認更新後版本

與第二章相同，於終端機輸入：

adb root
adb shell "dmesg | grep 'FW Version'"

確認版本已更新為 07-00-00-03。

第五章　常見問題與排查（Troubleshooting）

Q1：畫面出現 WARN Unable to use shared memory 會影響更新嗎？
此為系統內部記憶體配置警告，由寫入程式自動處理，不影響韌體更新結果。只要最終進度條達 100% 且版本號正確即可。
Q2：進度條沒有跑到 100% 或中途卡住？
請檢查硬體排線是否鬆脫，重新插拔排線並將裝置重啟後，再次執行腳本。
Q3：adb devices 顯示 unauthorized 或找不到裝置？
請於平板上允許「USB 偵錯」；並確認 adb root 已成功（回 restarting adbd as root）。adb.exe 就在 Scripts 資料夾內，於該路徑開 cmd 即可直接使用。

Touch Chip Firmware Update (FW Upgrade) User Guide

ILITek Touch FW Update SOP　|　Netronix

Full Walkthrough Demo Video

Screen recording, click to watch. Covers the full flow: adb reboot → get FW version → run the update → verify the updated version.

Chapter 1 · Preparation

  • Download the update package and unzip it (the package already includes adb.exe — no separate adb install needed).
  • Connect the device to the PC via USB Type-C.
📦 ILITek update package

Chapter 2 · Check the Current FW

After unzipping, open the Scripts folder (it contains adb.exe and FWUpgrade.bat).

In the address bar, type cmd to open a terminal.

First, run the following to reboot the device:

adb reboot

After the device finishes rebooting and adb reconnects, run the following to check the current Touch FW:

adb root
adb shell "dmesg | grep 'FW Version'"

The current version is shown, e.g. [ILITEK][MSG][0] [FW Version] 07-00-00-02, len: [4/4].
(The demo unit below is an older version, so it shows 07-00-00-00.)

⚠️ Important: query as soon as possible after a reboot
dmesg is a ring boot log; the ILITEK firmware info is printed early in boot (~9-10s). Run it as soon as possible after a reboot, otherwise it may be flooded/overwritten by later logs. If it is already gone, reboot and check again.

Chapter 3 · Run the Update

Double-click FWUpgrade.bat; it runs the update flow automatically:

The script runs an ADB connection check, pushes files, and reads the pre-update firmware info.

It then writes the firmware to the chip block by block with CRC verification:

updating block[6], data len: 1024...
block[6]: start/end addr... ic/file crc: 0xc230/0xc230 matched

Once the update succeeds and the progress bar reaches 100%, run the following to reboot the device:

adb reboot

Chapter 4 · Verify the Updated Version

Same as Chapter 2, run in the terminal:

adb root
adb shell "dmesg | grep 'FW Version'"

Confirm the version is now 07-00-00-03.

Chapter 5 · Troubleshooting

Q1: Does the on-screen WARN Unable to use shared memory affect the update?
It is an internal memory-allocation warning handled automatically; it does not affect the result. As long as the progress bar reaches 100% and the version is correct, it is fine.
Q2: The progress bar does not reach 100% or gets stuck?
Check the flex cable; re-seat it, restart the device, and run the script again.
Q3: adb devices shows unauthorized / device not found?
Allow "USB debugging" on the tablet, and make sure adb root succeeded (returns restarting adbd as root). adb.exe is in the Scripts folder, so opening cmd there lets you use adb directly.
